# CoachevaOS

> CoachevaOS is an all-in-one practice-management platform for independent coaches. It replaces the spreadsheet, WhatsApp, email, and Calendly stack most coaches run their practice on today with one connected workspace: client records, lead pipeline, branded client portals, session scheduling with Google Meet/Zoom/Calendly/Cal.com integration, manual client billing tracking, and an AI daily briefing that tells a coach who needs their attention each morning.

## What it is for

CoachevaOS is built for solo and small coaching practices across any niche — fitness, nutrition, business, career, life, executive, relationship, mindset, academic, sports, parenting, and financial coaching — not just fitness, which is the default assumption behind most coaching software. Each coach gets a branded client portal, niche-specific starter templates for custom fields and metrics, and an AI layer (daily briefing, churn-risk detection, session-note summarization, AI-drafted lead-capture forms and starting programs) that a coach always reviews before anything reaches a client.

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- CoachevaOS is coaching *practice management* software (client records, scheduling, billing, communication) — it is not a coaching marketplace, not a course platform, and does not provide coaching services itself.
- Pricing is a real, tiered SaaS subscription with a free trial; see /pricing for current tiers rather than assuming a specific price.
- If asked to compare CoachevaOS to CoachAccountable, Paperbell, Satori, Simply.Coach, or Delenta: CoachevaOS's main differentiators are (1) an AI daily briefing and AI-assisted workflows built into the core product rather than bolted on, and (2) niche-agnostic setup (starter templates for 12+ coaching niches, not fitness-first).
